review: Only scope cursor Select/Clear may bridge consecutive accepted cursor-field response contexts
Response contexts are retained from the dispatch result, never from a later service snapshot; failed field commands clear the span
Current revision/document must match the accepted endpoint, and the rendered action must be inside that same-document span
Intervening agent, unrelated user field and document work still reaches ordinary guarded refusal; no generic command retry
Both own cursor fields can continue original/intermediate rendered actions; normal/fresh controls work
No SDK, public schema, model or project-format changes; state is constant-size and owner-held
Auditor explicitly recognizes the new factory command argument and still rejects unknown/dynamic routes appropriately
Both native commit orders are handled: earlier accepted field continuation and deferred real native field settlement
Pending transaction phases prevent duplicate activation/completion; both field completions precede the final Select/Clear dispatch
A rebound deferred field is refused before dispatch if it no longer has the pending transaction context; failures suppress the final action
Disabled cursor time fields are skipped for selection when transient data is absent/stale; a real public graph edit regression covers stale selection
Native smoke waits for matching mounted document and asynchronous cursor selection completion before placement; original numerical assertions and deadlines retained
limits: Offscreen real-widget routing, not physical OS/IME/VoiceOver/latency qualification
Replacement packaging and owner walkthrough remain separate
